summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments on PR #481 by triaging, fixing, and replying to each unresolved thread.
summary.outcome: One unresolved CodeRabbit thread was addressed by correcting overstated audit verdict wording in a planning doc, then committed and pushed. No code changes were needed.

repo: The project uses pnpm with typecheck, test, and E2E (playwright) scripts, but these are skipped for documentation-only changes in .planning/
lint-staged prettier runs on commit as the relevant check for doc-only edits
PR #481 exists on the cipher-box repo (myankelev/cipher-box or similar) and has automated review from CodeRabbit

code.finding: Audit verdict claimed 'All 66 requirements have working implementations' but the doc itself showed a 62/66 score with PERF-01..04 as indirect-evidence only — verdict was corrected to separate verified from implemented

workflow: For doc-only changes, skipping typecheck/test/E2E is justified and should be stated explicitly when doing so
GraphQL reviewThreads query with isResolved filter is the right approach for fetching unresolved PR threads
Reply to threads via REST (--field for integer in_reply_to) and resolve via GraphQL mutation — these are separate API calls

open_items: PERF-01 through PERF-04 requirements remain in 'indirect evidence' status in the audit — not fully verified with direct implementations
